output.answer:
## Short answer: There is no Cargill FY2026 10-K, and no publicly reported GAAP net income or diluted EPS.

Cargill, Incorporated is a **privately held** company (family-owned, Wayzata/Minnetonka, MN). It does **not** file Forms 10-K, 10-Q, or 8-K with the SEC, and it is **not** subject to public-company reporting requirements. Its shares are not publicly traded, so it also does not report diluted EPS.

**What Cargill actually discloses (Annual Report, not a 10-K):**

| Metric | FY2026 | FY2025 | FY2024 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Revenue | **$164 billion** | $154 billion | $160 billion |

- FY2026 revenue of **$164B** is confirmed by Cargill's own 2026 Annual Report and CEO Brian Sikes' letter to stakeholders, released ~Aug 4, 2026.
- Cargill **does not publicly disclose net income, net earnings, or EPS** in its annual report. As the Star Tribune notes: *"Cargill... does not report its annual profit or other financial data."*
- Third-party reports sometimes cite internal/leaked figures (e.g., ~$3.57B net income for FY2025, up ~44% YoY), but these are **not official GAAP disclosures** and cannot be treated as filed financial statements.

**Why the searches may have misled you:** Some results surfaced SEC Form 10-Ks for **unrelated companies** that merely mention Cargill as a supplier/counterparty (e.g., The Mosaic Company, Coca-Cola), plus a separate "Annual Report 2025" from an unrelated company. These are not Cargill filings.

**Bottom line:** For Cargill, the only public financial figure for FY2026 is **revenue of $164 billion**. GAAP net income and diluted EPS for FY2026 are **not available** in any public filing, because no such filing exists.

- Cargill 2026 Annual Report: https://www.cargill.com/about/2026-annual-report
- Cargill 2026 letter to stakeholders: https://www.cargill.com/about/2026-annual-report/2026-letter-to-our-stakeholders
- Cargill Annual Report Library: https://www.cargill.com/sustainability/reporting-hub/annual-report-library
- Star Tribune (Cargill does not report profit/financial data): https://www.startribune.com/cargill-fiscal-2025-annual-revenue-down-154-billion-minnetonka-mn-agribusiness/601453847
- World Grain (FY2026 $164B revenue): https://www.world-grain.com/articles/23071-cargill-revenue-grows-amid-shifting-food-landscape
